extensionDescription.message: Highlights starred (flagged) messages in the message list with a background color, so they stand out.

enabledDesc.message: Gives starred (flagged) messages a background color in the message list, in both Table View and Cards View. The selected message keeps Thunderbird's own selection color.
enabledDesc.description: Table View and Cards View are the names Thunderbird gives the two message list layouts.

lightColorDesc.message: Pick a light shade, so the dark text stays readable.

darkColorDesc.message: Pick a dark shade, so the light text stays readable.

previewSample.description: Sample text in the color preview next to each color picker.

boldDesc.message: Shows starred messages in bold as well, even once they are read.
